info.name: TopWatch API
info.description: Collection covering the current back_topwatch endpoints: authentication (register, login, refresh, logout), user management (profile, list, get, delete), items (create, list, get, search), categories (list, filter by type) and watch lists (create, list, detail with associated items). Test scripts on the auth/create requests automatically save accessToken/refreshToken/userId/itemId/watchListId as collection variables so the rest of the requests work out of the box.

request.description: Creates a new account. Saves the returned tokens into {{access_token}} and {{refresh_token}} automatically.

response.name: 409 Conflict - Email or nickname already in use
400 Bad Request - Validation error

request.description: Authenticates the user. Saves the returned tokens into {{access_token}} and {{refresh_token}} automatically.
Sends the refresh token (not the access token) in the Authorization header and returns a new token pair.
Revokes the access token in the header and, optionally, the refresh token in the body. The refreshToken field can be omitted to only revoke the access token.
Returns the authenticated user's own profile. Saves the id into {{user_id}} automatically.

Creates an item owned by the authenticated user. type is one of BOOKS, SERIES, MOVIES, MUSIC. categoryIds is optional; omit or send [] for no categories. Saves the new id into {{item_id}} automatically.

400 Bad Request - Category id does not exist

Returns every category. Add a ?type=... query param to filter (see 'Get Categories By Type').
type is one of BOOKS, SERIES, MOVIES, MUSIC.

response.name: 400 Bad Request - Invalid type

request.description: Returns every watch list with only id and name. Saves the first list's id into {{watch_list_id}} automatically.
Creates a watch list owned by the authenticated user. Saves the new id into {{watch_list_id}} automatically.
Returns the watch list plus the items associated with it (each with its own watched/watchedDate/description and the full item).

response.name: 200 OK

request.description: Links one or more existing items (by id) to the watch list {{watch_list_id}}. Each new entry is saved with watched = false, watchedDate = the moment it was added, and no description. All items are added or none are: if any id fails a check, nothing is saved. Only the watch list creator can add items. Possible errors: 400 (empty list, null id, same id twice), 403 (not the owner), 404 (watch list or any item not found), 409 (any item already in the list).

response.name: 201 Created
400 Bad Request - Empty list
400 Bad Request - Repeated id
403 Forbidden - Not the owner
